# Pair data 
```{r}
# Function to extract accession ID and replicate
extract_info <- function(sample_name) {
  parts <- strsplit(sample_name, "_")[[1]]
  if (length(parts) >= 4) {
    accession_id <- parts[3]
    replicate <- parts[4]
    return(list(accession_id = accession_id, replicate = replicate))
  }
  return(NULL)
}

# Group samples by accession ID and replicate
samples_by_id <- list()
for (col in colnames(expression_df)) {
  # Special case for accession 6909
  if (grepl("6909", col)) {
    # Extract just the accession and replicate for 6909
    accession_id <- "6909"
    replicate_match <- regexpr("_[0-9]+(?=_[0-9]+$)", col, perl = TRUE)
    if (replicate_match > 0) {
      replicate <- substr(col, replicate_match + 1, replicate_match + attr(replicate_match, "match.length") - 1)
      key <- paste(accession_id, replicate, sep = "_")
      if (!(key %in% names(samples_by_id))) {
        samples_by_id[[key]] <- c()
      }
      samples_by_id[[key]] <- c(samples_by_id[[key]], col)
    }
  } else {
    # Normal case for other accessions
    info <- extract_info(col)
    if (!is.null(info)) {
      key <- paste(info$accession_id, info$replicate, sep = "_")
      #print(key)
      if (!(key %in% names(samples_by_id))) {
        samples_by_id[[key]] <- c()
      }
      samples_by_id[[key]] <- c(samples_by_id[[key]], col)
    }
  }
}

# Create sample pairs
sample_pairs <- list()
unpaired_col <- c()
unpaired_ddm1 <- c()

for (key in names(samples_by_id)) {
  samples <- samples_by_id[[key]]
  # For accession 6909, use case-insensitive matching for Col
  if (grepl("^6909_", key)) {
    col_samples <- samples[grepl("[Cc]ol", samples, ignore.case = TRUE)]
    ddm1_samples <- samples[grepl("ddm1", samples)]
  } else {
    # For other accessions, use the original approach
    col_samples <- samples[grepl("Col", samples)]
    ddm1_samples <- samples[grepl("ddm1", samples)]
  }
  
  # Pair samples if both Col and ddm1 exist
  if (length(col_samples) > 0 && length(ddm1_samples) > 0) {
    sample_pairs[[col_samples[1]]] <- ddm1_samples[1]
  } else {
    if (length(col_samples) > 0) {
      unpaired_col <- c(unpaired_col, col_samples)
    }
    if (length(ddm1_samples) > 0) {
      unpaired_ddm1 <- c(unpaired_ddm1, ddm1_samples)
    }
  }
}

# Print the resulting pairs

#  ddm1_sample <- sample_pairs[[col_sample]]
#  cat(sprintf("Paired: %s <-> %s\n", col_sample, ddm1_sample))
#}

```
# Create a difference dataframe
```{r}
diff_df <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(expression_df))
col0_df <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(expression_df))
ddm1_df <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(expression_df))
# Calculate differences and only keep Col samples
for (col_sample in names(sample_pairs)) {
  ddm1_sample <- sample_pairs[[col_sample]]
  if (col_sample %in% colnames(expression_df) && 
      ddm1_sample %in% colnames(expression_df)) {
    # Create diff, ddm1 and col0 dfs 
    diff_df[[col_sample]] <- expression_df[[ddm1_sample]] - expression_df[[col_sample]]
    col0_df[[col_sample]] <- expression_df[[col_sample]]
    ddm1_df[[ddm1_sample]] <- expression_df[[ddm1_sample]]
    
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Starting with your normalized expression matrix (genes × samples)
# With samples including both conditions and replicates
## Extract replicate
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

diff_df_t <- as.data.frame(t(ddm1_df))

diff_df_t$Replicate <- as.numeric(str_extract(rownames(diff_df_t), "(?<=_)[0-9]+(?=_[0-9]+$)"))

diff_df_t$accession <- str_extract(rownames(diff_df_t), "(?:[^_]+_){2}([^_]+)")
diff_df_t$accession <- gsub("F1_ddm1_", "", diff_df_t$accession)
diff_df_t$accession <- gsub("ct_col_","", diff_df_t$accession)
diff_df_t$accession <- gsub("F1_Col_","", diff_df_t$accession)
diff_df_t$accession <- gsub("ddm1_ct","", diff_df_t$accession)


# Assuming your data is in a dataframe called 'expression_df'
# First, make sure the row names are preserved as a column
diff_df_t$sample_name <- rownames(diff_df_t)

# Identify the columns to pivot (all except accession, Replicate, and sample_name)
id_cols <- c("sample_name", "accession", "Replicate")
value_cols <- setdiff(colnames(diff_df_t), id_cols)

# Convert to long format
long_df <- diff_df_t %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(value_cols),
    names_to = "TE_id",
    values_to = "expression"
  )

avg_data <- long_df %>%
  group_by(accession) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(avg_expression = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE))

# Make separated replicates

avg_data2 <- long_df %>%
  group_by(accession, Replicate) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(avg_expression = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE))

wide_data <- avg_data2 %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = accession,
    names_from = Replicate,
    values_from = avg_expression,
    names_prefix = "expression_"
  )
```

## Calculate heritability 
```{r}
# Make sure variables are properly formatted
library(lme4)

long_df$TE_id <- as.factor(long_df$TE_id)
long_df$accession <- as.factor(long_df$accession)
long_df$Replicate <- as.factor(long_df$Replicate)

model <- lmer(expression ~ (1|TE_id) + (1|accession) + (1|TE_id:accession) + (1|Replicate), data = long_df)
blups_accession <- ranef(model)$accession

# If you want to see the BLUPs
print(blups_accession)
## Get variance
varcomp <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
var_accession <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "accession"]
var_te_accession <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "TE_id:accession"]
var_replicate <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "Replicate"]
var_te<- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "TE_id"]
var_residual <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "Residual"]
# Calculate heritability
total_variance <-   var_accession+var_replicate+ var_residual +var_te_accession+var_te
h2 <- var_accession / (total_variance)
print(h2*100)

# Get proportion explained by each contributer
prop_accession <- var_accession / total_variance
prop_replicate <- var_replicate / total_variance
prop_te<- var_te / total_variance
prop_te_accession <- var_te_accession / total_variance
prop_residual <- var_residual / total_variance


## Get proportion explained 
variance_df <- data.frame(
  Component = c("accession","te:accession","replicate","residual", "te"),
  Variance = c(prop_accession,prop_te_accession,prop_replicate,prop_residual,prop_te )
)

# Plot 
variance_df$Component <- factor(variance_df$Component, 
                              levels =c("accession","te:accession","replicate","residual", "te"))

ggplot(variance_df, aes(x = Component, y = Variance, fill = Component)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Variance * 100)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
            vjust = -0.5,size = 3.4)

```


## Calculate Heritability on each TE 

```{r}
# Install and load pbapply if necessary
# install.packages("pbapply")
library(pbapply)

library(lme4)
library(pbapply)  # For progress bar (optional)

# Function to calculate heritability for each TE
calculate_te_heritability <- function(data) {
  # Get unique TE_ids
  te_ids <- unique(data$TE_id)
  
  # Initialize results dataframe
  results <- data.frame(
    TE_id = character(),
    heritability = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Loop through each TE with progress bar
  results <- do.call(rbind, pblapply(te_ids, function(te) {
    # Subset data for current TE
    te_data <- data[data$TE_id == te, ]
    
    # Fit mixed model (adjust random effects as needed)
    model <- lmer(expression ~ 1 + (1|accession) + (1|Replicate), 
                  data = te_data)
    
    # Extract variance components
    vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
    var_accession <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "accession"]
    var_residual <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "Residual"]
    
    # Calculate heritability (H² = Var(Accession) / (Var(Accession) + Var(Residual)))
    h2 <- var_accession / (var_accession + var_residual)
    
    # Return results for this TE
    data.frame(TE_id = te, heritability = h2)
  }))
  
  return(results)
}

# Run the function
heritability_results <- calculate_te_heritability(long_df)

# Plot 
results <- heritability_results %>%
  arrange(heritability) %>%  # Arrange in increasing order
  mutate(TE = factor(TE_id, levels = TE_id))  # Set factor levels to enforce order

ggplot(, aes(x = TE, y = heritability, fill = heritability)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +  
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +  
  labs(title = "Heritability of TEs", x = "TE", y = "Heritability") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())
```

```{r}
var_components <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))

# Variance components
var_sample <- var_components$vcov[var_components$grp == "accession"] # Variance for 'sample'
#var_planting <- var_components$vcov[var_components$grp == "Planting"]   # Variance for 'replicate'
var_repl <- var_components$vcov[var_components$grp == "Replicate"]  
var_residual <-var_residual <- attr(VarCorr(model), "sc")^2

total_variance <- var_sample + var_repl + var_residual

# Calculate heritability
heritability <- var_sample / (var_sample + var_repl + var_residual)
cat("Heritability (H^2):", heritability, "\n")



# Proportion of variance explained by each effect
prop_sample <- var_sample / total_variance
prop_replicate <- var_repl / total_variance
prop_residual <- var_residual / total_variance

# Print the results
cat("Variance explained by sample: ", prop_sample, "\n")
cat("Variance explained by replicate: ", prop_replicate, "\n")
cat("Variance explained by residuals: ", prop_residual, "\n")
```

```{r}
df_long <- phenotype_sum_with_metainfo %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("rep"), names_to = "replicate", values_to = "trait_value") 

df_long$replicate <- gsub("rep", "", df_long$replicate)
df_long$replicate <- as.numeric(df_long$replicate)
phenotype_sum_with_sample_info <- inner_join(sampleData,df_long, by=c("Accession"="sample","Replicate"="replicate") )


phenotype_sum_with_sample_info$Replicate <- as.factor(phenotype_sum_with_sample_info$Replicate)
phenotype_sum_with_sample_info$Accession <- as.factor(phenotype_sum_with_sample_info$Accession)
phenotype_sum_with_sample_info$trait_value <- as.numeric(phenotype_sum_with_sample_info$trait_value)
phenotype_sum_with_sample_info$country <- as.factor(phenotype_sum_with_sample_info$country)
phenotype_sum_with_sample_info$Planting <- as.factor(phenotype_sum_with_sample_info$Planting)
#df_long <- df_long[df_long$sample!=7025 & df_long$sample!=424 & df_long$sample!=8419 & df_long$sample!=108 & df_long$sample!=9894 & df_long$sample!=9812  & df_long$sample!=9805,]
# Fit the linear mixed model
model <- lmer(trait_value ~ (1 | Accession)+ (1 | Replicate)+ (1|Planting), data = phenotype_sum_with_sample_info)
# Pull random effects
ranef(model)
summary(model)

residuals <- resid(model)

# Plot histogram of residuals
hist(residuals, breaks = 30, main = "Histogram of Residuals", xlab = "Residuals", col = "darkgreen")

#plot(residuals,df_long$sample)
#plot(residuals,df_long$replicate)
```

```{r}
var_components <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))

# Variance components
var_sample <- var_components$vcov[var_components$grp == "Accession"] # Variance for 'sample'
var_planting <- var_components$vcov[var_components$grp == "Planting"]   # Variance for 'replicate'
var_repl <- var_components$vcov[var_components$grp == "Replicate"]  
var_residual <-var_residual <- attr(VarCorr(model), "sc")^2

total_variance <- var_sample + var_planting+ var_repl + var_residual

# Calculate heritability
heritability <- var_sample / (var_sample + var_planting+ var_repl + var_residual)
cat("Heritability (H^2):", heritability, "\n")



# Proportion of variance explained by each effect
prop_sample <- var_sample / total_variance
prop_planting <- var_planting / total_variance
prop_replicate <- var_repl / total_variance
prop_residual <- var_residual / total_variance

# Print the results
cat("Variance explained by sample: ", prop_sample, "\n")
cat("Variance explained by planting: ", prop_planting, "\n")
cat("Variance explained by replicate: ", prop_replicate, "\n")
cat("Variance explained by residuals: ", prop_residual, "\n")
```

```{r}
# Construct the formula: random effect for each SNP
snps_heritability_with_phenotype$V10 <- as.numeric(snps_heritability_with_phenotype$V10)
snp_formula <- paste("V10 ~ (1|", paste(colnames(snps_heritability_with_phenotype)[2:9], collapse = ") + (1|"), ")", sep = "")
# Fit the mixed model
model <- lmer(as.formula(snp_formula), data = snps_heritability_with_phenotype)
# Summary of the model
summary(model)
```



```{r}
# Extract variance components
var_comp <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))

# Calculate genetic variance (sum of random effect variances)
genetic_variance <- sum(var_comp$vcov)

# Residual variance
residual_variance <- attr(VarCorr(model), "sc")^2

# Narrow-sense heritability
h2 <- genetic_variance / (genetic_variance + residual_variance)
cat("Narrow-sense heritability (h2):", h2, "\n")

```

```{r}
# Install and load pbapply if necessary
# install.packages("pbapply")
library(pbapply)

voom_normalized_values$sample <- NULL
voom_normalized_values$Replicate_clean<- NULL
calculate_te_heritability <- function(data) {
  # Get all columns except last 3 (these are the TEs)
  te_cols <- colnames(data)[1:(ncol(data)-3)]
  
  # Create empty data frame for results
  results <- data.frame(
    TE = character(),
    heritability = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Loop through each TE with progress bar
  results <- pblapply(te_cols, function(te) {
    # Create subset with current TE and the last 3 columns
    subset_data <- data[, c(te, tail(colnames(data), 3))]
    colnames(subset_data)[1] <- "expression"
    
    # Fit model
    model <- lmer(expression ~ (1|Variant) + (1|Accession) + (1|Replicate), 
                  data = subset_data)
    
    # Get variance components
    var_components <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
    
    # Calculate heritability
    var_accession <- var_components$vcov[var_components$grp == "Accession"] 
    var_replicate <- var_components$vcov[var_components$grp == "Replicate"] 
    var_variant <- var_components$vcov[var_components$grp == "Variant"] 
    var_residuals <- attr(VarCorr(model), "sc")^2 
    total_var <- var_accession + var_replicate + var_variant + var_residuals
    heritability <- var_accession / total_var
    
    # Return results
    data.frame(TE = te, heritability = heritability)
  })
  
  # Convert the list of results to a data frame
  results <- do.call(rbind, results)
  
  return(results)
}

results <- calculate_te_heritability(voom_normalized_values)
head(results)

# Plot 
results <- results %>%
  arrange(heritability) %>%  # Arrange in increasing order
  mutate(TE = factor(TE, levels = TE))  # Set factor levels to enforce order

ggplot(results, aes(x = TE, y = heritability, fill = heritability)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +  
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +  
  labs(title = "Heritability of TEs", x = "TE", y = "Heritability") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())


ggplot(results, aes(heritability)) +
  geom_histogram()+theme_bw(base_size = 15)

#Filter results

results <- results[results$heritability>0.2,]
str(results[results$heritability>0.5,])
hist(results$heritability)

rownames(results) <- results$TE
results$TE<-rownames(results) 

## Add TE names
te_annot <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/tes_annotation_with_superfamily.csv", sep=",")
# Filter out rows where Super.Family is NA or starts with "NA"
te_annot <- te_annot[!is.na(te_annot$Super.Family) & !grepl("^NA", te_annot$Super.Family), ]

# Filter out rows where Name starts with a space or is missing
te_annot <- te_annot[!grepl("^\\s", te_annot$Super.Family) & te_annot$Super.Family != "" & !is.na(te_annot$Super.Family), ]

results_with_family <- inner_join(te_annot, results, by=c("Name"="TE"))

# Create the heatmap
ggplot(results_with_family, aes(x = reorder(Name, heritability), y = heritability, fill = heritability)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +  # Flip the axes to make the TEs easier to read
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +  # Color gradient based on heritability
  labs(title = "Heritability of TEs", x = "TE", y = "Heritability") +
  theme_minimal()+ theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11)) 

# Arrange heritability in descending order within each family
results_with_family <- results_with_family %>%
  group_by(Super.Family) %>%
  arrange(-desc(heritability), .by_group = TRUE) %>%  
  ungroup()

# Create a factor for TE names to order them within each Super.Family
results_with_family <- results_with_family %>%
  mutate(Name = factor(Name, levels = Name))

family_counts <- results_with_family %>%
  count(Super.Family) %>%
  arrange(n)

# Reorder Super.Family factor levels based on counts
results_with_family <- results_with_family %>%
  mutate(Super.Family = factor(Super.Family, levels = family_counts$Super.Family))

results_with_family <- results_with_family[results_with_family$Super.Family!='<NA>',]
# Create the heatmap
ggplot(results, aes(x = TE, y = heritability, fill = heritability)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +  # Flip the axes
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +  # Color gradient
  labs(title = "Heritability of TEs", x = "TE", y = "Heritability") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15))
```
